title: Halls where he played
summary: He names Economy Hall, other society halls, the Tulane Club and a merry-go-round job, used for dances, banquets and weddings.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Can you remember a few of the places you played, even if they were only for a night or two sometimes, some of the old halls, you know?
Well, I played at the Economy Hall, I played at the Poiseuilers Hall, at the New Hall, at the Hopes Hall.
Yeah. They tore that down at last. Yeah, they tore it down because of the storm damage. After the hurricane last September. Mm-hmm.
And I played at the merry-go-round once. It was way up in town.
Oh, it's still up there, I guess. Yeah. They still have parades, way up there. Yeah. I played at the Tulane Club. Yeah, that's still there, I guess. Yeah. Uh huh. Gravier, I believe.
Well, them is all noted halls for dances and banquets and weddings and things.
